facts.text: The resort is in the small village of Orasac, 11 km from Dubrovnik city centre.
facts.excerpt: Resort Sun Gardens Dubrovnik is located in the small village of Orašac, only 11 km from Dubrovnik city centre.

facts.text: Sun Gardens Dubrovnik is a beachfront resort.
facts.excerpt: Step into a world of leisure and fun hidden in a beautiful beachfront resort.

facts.text: The resort has three swimming pools and a beach with a private VIP area.
facts.excerpt: Find your favourite lounging spot at one of the three swimming pools at the resort, or visit the beach just a few steps away and reserve your place in a private VIP area.

facts.text: The resort beach is a pebble beach.
facts.excerpt: Dip into one of 3 outdoor pools, or visit the resort pebble beach, Spa and Sports Centre

facts.text: The sports centre offers more than a dozen sports and activities.
facts.excerpt: sports center offering more than a dozen sports and activities

facts.text: The Marco Polo Kids Club runs a day and evening schedule for children of any age.
facts.excerpt: Enter an enchanting world of fun for children of any age. Enjoy a varied day and evening schedule filled with adventures that your little ones will remember for a lifetime.

facts.text: The Children Sports Academy runs weekly football, tennis, squash, swimming and water-sports programmes for children aged 7 to 15.
facts.excerpt: Our Sports Academy offers football, tennis, squash, swimming and water-sports weekly programmes to children 7 to 15 led by experienced coaches in a fun and safe environment.

facts.text: Guests can choose a hotel room, a suite, a private residence or a villa.
facts.excerpt: Choose between a hotel room, suite, a private residence or Villa and let a true Mediterranean holiday begin.

facts.text: The resort villa is a five-bedroom sea-view villa with a private pool.
facts.excerpt: 5 Bedroom Sea View Villa with Private Pool

facts.text: Sun Gardens FESTA is a summer programme of themed dining and entertainment events and parties.
facts.excerpt: Explore FESTA, our versatile and attractive summer program of _themed_ dining and entertainment events and parties catering to all tastes and all generations.

facts.text: The resort's dining includes traditional Dalmatian dishes as well as cuisines from other parts of the world.
facts.excerpt: Taste traditional Dalmatian dishes or explore cuisines from other parts of the world

facts.text: The resort has an organic vegetable garden that guests can enjoy.
facts.excerpt: Guests can enjoy our organic vegetable garden, participate in community engagement activities, and support biodiversity efforts.

facts.text: The resort holds the Green Key LHW Sustainability Leader certificate.
facts.excerpt: We proudly hold the Green Key LHW Sustainability Leader certificate

facts.text: A resort web app lets guests reserve experiences, book tables and order food and drinks online.
facts.excerpt: Explore the resort through our web app, reserve your experiences, book your table, or order your food and drinks online.

facts.text: A shopping promenade sits in the heart of the resort.
facts.excerpt: Explore the shopping promenade, located in the heart of the resort, offering everything you may need for a relaxed holiday.

facts.text: The resort has free outdoor parking.
facts.excerpt: FREE OUTDOOR PARKING

facts.text: Guests can follow suggested hiking, running or cycling routes.
facts.excerpt: Whether you prefer hiking, running or cycling, set your own pace and choose the route that suits you best, exploring spectacular views and fascinating sights on one of our suggested paths.

facts.text: The resort can arrange vehicle rentals, private tours and airport transfers.
facts.excerpt: Whether it is renting a vehicle for your new land or sea-based adventure, organizing a private tour, or an airport transfer, we have got you covered.

facts.text: The Spa Centre is described as luxurious and award-winning.
facts.excerpt: The luxurious and award-winning Spa Centre is meant for moments of absolute indulgence.

facts.text: The resort has modular meeting rooms and outdoor event venues.
facts.excerpt: state of the art, modular meeting rooms, and a large choice of attractive outdoor venues

facts.text: Dubrovnik is a UNESCO World Heritage city.
facts.excerpt: located in the community of Orašac, 11 kilometres from the UNESCO World Heritage city of Dubrovnik
